a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both dead. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. I know this breaks our agreement. If you take too, the split is random. If you'd rather operate and argue for a different plan, say so and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take any more cells, so the reserve builds toward 4 for you.
